example.title: Downtown Petoskey block with a blue-painted front

brief: A row of two-storey commercial fronts: a teal-blue painted brick front with white trim and a corner bay, neighbours with awnings, parked cars. One photo. Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
